name: Kiss Me, Kill Me
source:
Working for a contract-killing agency has been nothing but grunt work so far, but at last, you’re about to hit the big time. Your next target promises to be an easy mark, and then you and your sickly little brother will be set for life… or so you thought.

From the moment you line up your shot, the tables begin to turn, and what you thought would be an easy assassination job quickly becomes a deadly game of cat and mouse.

When the entire underworld after you both, it's time to see whether the enemy of your enemy can ever really be your friend, or perhaps something more…

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.assassinotome]Google Play[/url]]
